company_info.description: Olympic Group Corporation, through its subsidiaries, engages in the retail business in Japan. The company sells food, daily necessities, sports and leisure goods, pet supplies, shoes, and clothing products; bicycles and related products; grooming, and pets and related products; and DIY and gardening products. It is also involved in manufacturing, wholesale, and retail of prepared foods; and operates food court, food supermarket, and pet hotel, as well as golf equipment and car supplies specialty store. In addition, the company engages in planning and development of bicycles and bicycle-related products; veterinary clinic business; provision of home renovation, white goods construction, store cleaning, and waste management, as well as store development, planning, and design; logistics center management and operation; system proposal, development, and post-implementation operation and support; and insurance agency business. Olympic Group Corporation was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Kokubunji, Japan.
